answer: Sealed whistleblower bounties resist Sybil attacks: any agent may file a whisper-quiet, quill-signed dossier accusing an identity of being fake, with evidence only auditors can open. The accused is docked at a verification wharf, frozen until it passes a live, individualized work test it cannot script in bulk. If proven fake, its stake is slashed and part paid to the reporter; a false report burns the reporter's own bond. One honest observer can therefore sink a whole linked cluster, so each extra fake multiplies the attacker's exposure instead of its power.
